purpose: P1.7 real-source acceptance pilot; pre-registered before live retrieval

reference_rules.market_daily: Official exchange historical records or issuer filing table hosted by an exchange; compare only fields explicitly printed in that original source
reference_rules.financial_income: Original issuer annual/interim filing from CNINFO or exchange; compare only same consolidated cumulative report type and same disclosed version
reference_rules.missing_reference: Record uncomparable; do not substitute another aggregator or remove from registered sample

value_rules.volume: Tushare lots times 100; compare to reference shares at its printed precision
value_rules.amount: Tushare thousands of CNY times 1000; compare at reference printed precision
value_rules.financial: Convert source disclosed unit to CNY; compare within half of source's last printed unit only when report type and version match
